description: Returns how long one food keeps in the fridge, freezer and pantry, for each state the guide lists (unopened, opened, cooked, ...), with the best way to store it, spoilage signs, freezing and thawing, myths, advice for people at higher risk, common questions, sources and the page URL. Pass a slug from search_foods, or a food name.

food.description: A slug from search_foods (for example 'yogurt') or a food name.

language.description: Language of the answer: tr, en, de, es, fr, it, ru, ja or ar. Defaults to the language the food was found in.

name: get_storage_guide
title: Get a food's storage times
